findings.finding: Created gateways expose OwnerId, InternetGatewayId, Attachments=[], and supplied Tags; attached state is available, not attached. ID selection and filters intersect; owner, attachment VPC/state, tag-key and tag:value filters are exercised.
Attach is not idempotent: the same gateway already attached (same or another owned VPC) returns Resource.AlreadyAssociated. Another gateway into an occupied VPC returns InvalidParameterValue.

Deleting an attached gateway returns DependencyViolation. Detaching an unattached gateway or from the wrong VPC returns Gateway.NotAttached. Repeated deletion of a deleted gateway returns InvalidInternetGatewayID.NotFound.

Authorized DryRun takes precedence over the exercised dependency, already-attached, deleted-ID, invalid-filter, malformed-target, missing-target/destination, and invalid local-route cases: DryRunOperation, not the ordinary validation error.

CreateRoute canonicalizes 198.51.100.19/24 to 198.51.100.0/24. ReplaceRoute and DeleteRoute also accept that noncanonical host-bit input for the existing canonical route, despite exact-match language in the API reference.

Duplicate CreateRoute with the same valid target succeeds, for either canonical or noncanonical destination. A different valid attached gateway for an existing destination returns RouteAlreadyExists; it does not replace. Target validation can precede duplicate detection: the detached or wrong-VPC gateway returns InvalidParameterValue.

Unattached/wrong-VPC gateway route targets return InvalidParameterValue (different networks). A deleted gateway returns InvalidGatewayID.NotFound for CreateRoute/ReplaceRoute, unlike InvalidInternetGatewayID.NotFound on gateway lifecycle APIs.

All three route mutations require exactly one destination: omitted gives MissingParameter, multiple gives InvalidParameterCombination, malformed IPv4 CIDR gives InvalidParameterValue. Create/Replace require exactly one target; missing/multiple target errors are MissingParameter/InvalidParameterCombination.

Missing existing destination differs by API: ReplaceRoute returns InvalidParameterValue with Use CreateRoute instead; DeleteRoute returns InvalidRoute.NotFound. Deleted table: Create/Replace return InvalidRouteTableID.NotFound, but DeleteRoute returns InvalidRoute.NotFound.

Local routes cannot be deleted. GatewayId=local is not a valid route mutation target and returns InvalidGatewayID.NotFound. IGW targets for equal-to or more-specific-than VPC CIDRs are rejected with InvalidParameterValue (only interface or instance allowed).

ReplaceRoute LocalTarget=true on the existing local CIDR succeeds repeatedly and retains Origin=CreateRouteTable; on a nonlocal destination it returns InvalidParameterValue. LocalTarget=false alone is missing a target; LocalTarget=true plus GatewayId is an invalid combination.

Detaching a gateway succeeds even while routes reference it; routes remain with the same GatewayId and Origin=CreateRoute but State=blackhole. Reattaching the same gateway restores State=active. Deleting that detached gateway succeeds and leaves referencing routes blackhole. Replacing one route with a newly attached gateway makes that route active; untouched deleted-gateway routes remain blackhole.
Unassociated custom route tables can be deleted with local and nonlocal routes still present; routes alone are not a table-deletion dependency. Dry-run deletion of a route leaves it visible.

Native successful Attach/Detach/DeleteInternetGateway, ReplaceRoute, and DeleteRoute XML carries <return>true</return> even where AWS CLI output is {}. Preserve native XML separately from SDK-modeled JSON. CreateRoute exposes Return=true.

CloudTrail matches all 129 scoped API request IDs, including DryRun and native validation failures. Errors are Client.<native code> with responseElements=null; successful mutations use responseElements.requestId and _return=true. Successful DescribeInternetGateways has responseElements=null. CreateInternetGateway includes internetGateway fields and empty association/attachmentSet objects. No new audit infrastructure was created.
